findings.claim: UPHELD. Expected: every read-role attempt, including resume, invalidates the envelope when HEAD or the snapshot worktree changes. Found: _launch calls _settle; _resume does not call _settle, _residual, or compare HEAD, then writes result and leaves status closed so wait is terminal; _close skips _settle once result exists. Codex check-tests is role read and now workspace-write; resume argv omits --sandbox. The settlement skip is pre-existing; this change makes it the integrity control the new CONTRACT text names. Live Codex writes were not executed. Bounded correction: run the same read-role settlement after every resume attempt; do not skip it on close because result is already populated.
findings.reproduce: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c 'import ast,pathlib; t=ast.parse(pathlib.Path("ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py").read_text()); fs={n.name:n for n in t.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}; calls=lambda f:{n.func.id for n in ast.walk(fs[f]) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name)}; assert "_settle" in calls("_launch") and "_settle" not in calls("_resume"); print("launch settles; resume does not")' && sed -n '174,184p;1678,1709p' ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md

findings.claim: UPHELD. Expected: resume binds snapshot.root to <DISPATCH_JOBS>/<id>/snapshot before acting. Found: _find_record loads the JSON path with no _inside check; record.validate accepts /outside-the-job, /tmp, ../../etc, and a missing root; the new Codex check-tests chmod walk uses Path(rec['snapshot']['root']) before Popen. record.py is unchanged from base; the chmod is new. No outside tree was chmod'd. Bounded correction: bind snapshot.root to the job snapshot (refuse unless contained) before chmod, os.walk, cwd, and the sibling record.json write, and constrain record.validate the same way.
